title: ServerBench: How can your coding agents design specialized LLM serving systems?
abstract: arXiv:2611.06841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents develop software through experimentation, offering an opportunity to design the serving systems supporting their own operation. Effective serving requires coordinating implementation and operating decisions under session dependencies, latency constraints, and correctness requirements. We introduce ServerBench, a benchmark for agentic design of complete, specialized LLM serving systems. Agents experiment against a common objective, dollars per dollar: latency-qualified token value per dollar of GPU cost. Stateful replay preserves session dependencies, and independent verification checks the submitted system. Across 11 coding-agent models and three deployments, Claude Sonnet 5.5 achieves 2.97 dollars per dollar on Gemma E4B, $4.87\times$ the vLLM reference; 22 of 33 runs yield verified systems, and 13 exceed the strongest baseline. translated_title: ServerBench：你的编程智能体如何设计专用的大语言模型服务系统？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06841v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）编程智能体通过实验来开发软件，这为设计支撑其自身运行的服务系统提供了契机。有效的服务需要在会话依赖、延迟约束和正确性要求下协调实现与运营决策。我们提出了ServerBench，一个面向智能体化设计完整、专用LLM服务系统的基准。智能体围绕一个共同目标进行实验：每美元收益，即每美元GPU成本所产生的满足延迟要求的token价值。有状态重放保留了会话依赖关系，独立验证机制则对提交的系统进行检查。在11个编程智能体模型和三种部署环境的测试中，Claude Sonnet 5.5在Gemma E4B上取得了2.97的每美元收益，达到vLLM参考实现的4.87倍；33次运行中有22次产出了通过验证的系统，其中13次超越了最强基线。我们的分析识别出三项发现：高价值的设计协调……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出ServerBench，首个让编程智能体以“每美元收益”为目标通过实验自主设计并验证专用LLM服务系统的基准，其中Claude Sonnet 5.5的设计达到vLLM基线的4.87倍。
en_tdlr: ServerBench is the first benchmark enabling coding agents to autonomously design and verify specialized LLM serving systems through experimentation toward a "dollars per dollar" objective, with Claude Sonnet 5.5's design achieving 4.87x the vLLM baseline.
